messages:
maria: Heads up — onboarding tenant Orion needs GPU quota lifted in eu-west-6 for multiple accounts. Requesting p5 (2 units), g5 (8 units), and ENI increase across accounts. Account IDs: 123456789012 (orion-prod), 210987654321 (orion-staging). Target window: next 2 weeks. Can infra own the AWS quota escalation? :pray:

# derek: I'll start with AWS support now. Can you paste the account IDs and expected peak vGPU count and a short justification? AWS usually asks for business justification and forecast.

maria: Sure — pasted above. Peak concurrent GPUs: 10 across prod, staging bursts to 14 for A/B test. Justification: latency-sensitive EU inference for customer-facing features; traffic forecast uploaded to Drive (link).

lina: Adding perf context — p5 needed for long-context runs (~2k tokens) to keep p95 <200ms. G5 for cheaper batch/throughput work. Also we need ENI quota bumped from 1000 -> 3000 org-wide so pods can scale across AZs.

raj: FYI we hit a soft Accelerators per region limit last week. Recommend requesting a fallback p4d:1 unit in case p5 capacity is delayed by AWS. I'll draft templated justification text.

# derek: Filed support case: 9876543210. Quotas requested: P5-Family: 2, G5-Family: 8, ENIs: +2000. Uploaded justification and traffic CSV. AWS asked for estimated monthly spend — can someone confirm numbers?

maria: Initial runway estimate $35k/month, expect growth to ~$80k/month within 3 months once feature ramps. Put that in the case comment.

quota-bot: Created internal tracking ticket INFRA-3421 and linked to AWS case 9876543210. :white_check_mark:

aws-support-bot: AWS case 9876543210: Request received by AWS. Typical review SLA ~3 business days. Monitor case for follow-up questions.

lina: Once approved we should reserve capacity and update the tenant onboarding runbook to allocate the dedicated pool. Also need to update k8s cloud provider ENI limits in cluster config; opening PR to helm values.

maria: If AWS pushes back on eu-west-6, prefer fallback regions eu-west-1 then eu-central-1. Please keep me posted.

raj: Noted. Tagging @sre for capacity and alerting readiness.

sre: We'll prepare temporary autoscale policies, capacity alarms, and a rollback plan if quotas aren't available. Also will test ENI scaling in a sandbox account. :thumbsup:
